description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseResponse' intended for use as a common superclass for API response messages within the 'Microsoft.eShopWeb.PublicApi' namespace. It includes constructors for setting a correlation ID and inherits from 'BaseMessage'.

classes.name: BaseResponse
classes.description: An abstract class serving as the base for API response objects, providing constructors for initializing response messages with an optional correlation ID.

methods.name: BaseResponse(Guid correlationId)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the response with a specific correlation ID by calling the base class constructor.

methods.name: BaseResponse()
methods.description: Default constructor for creating a response instance without setting a correlation ID.
